description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDirectoryDao class which extends from BaseDao and provides methods for retrieving employee data from a database within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for fetching employee lists, counting employees, and querying employees by employee number, with filters for name, ID, location, and job title.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for retrieving employee data from the database, with methods supporting various search and filtering options.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper object with filters applied based on search parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a single Employee entity using its employee number.
